events.title: The Nutcracker – Bolshoi Ballet
events.description: The Bolshoi Ballet and the Bolshoi Theatre Orchestra bring Yuri Grigorovich's production of Tchaikovsky's Christmas ballet to Dubai Opera. Conducted by Pavel Klinichev, co-presented by Dubai Opera and Art Seasons.

events.title: Abracadabra
events.description: A comedy play about two struggling theatre companies that end up staging a show in an abandoned theatre where strange things start to happen. Part of the Dubai Opera season.

events.title: Wasla Festival – Marcel Khalife, Le Trio Joubran, TootArd
events.description: A one-night open-air festival of Arab music with Marcel Khalife, Le Trio Joubran, TootArd and Fatima. Doors open at 4:30 pm and the 2026 edition supports UNHCR's work with displaced families.

events.title: ARTBAT presents Upperground
events.description: Ukrainian duo ARTBAT host their Upperground electronic music night, joined by Miss Monique, R3HAB and 7 SKIES.

events.title: Yasalam After-Race Concert: The Chainsmokers & The Script
events.description: The Chainsmokers and The Script close the 2026 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix after-race concerts on race day. Entry is for Grand Prix ticket holders, with Golden Circle upgrades on sale.
events.price_text: With an Abu Dhabi Grand Prix ticket

events.title: Madinat Jumeirah Festive Market
events.description: A free Christmas market with stalls, seasonal food, a 36-foot tree with light shows, a carousel and abra rides. Opens at 3 pm Monday to Thursday and at noon Friday to Sunday.

events.title: Meet Santa & Snow Park at Ski Dubai
events.venue: Ski Dubai, Mall of the Emirates
events.description: Santa's grotto and village inside Ski Dubai, combined with Snow Park access. The package includes a printed photo with Santa, hot chocolate and winter clothing; not for children under 2.

events.title: JLT Winter Festival
events.description: A free community winter festival in JLT Park. Open 4–9 pm on weekdays and until 10 pm at weekends; registration is online.

events.title: Meet Santa at Snow Abu Dhabi
events.description: A Christmas meet-and-greet with Santa at Snow Abu Dhabi, with a gift, goodie bag, photo and hot chocolate. Booked online; Snow Park entry is not included.

events.title: Sharjah Architecture Triennial: Architecture Otherwise
events.venue: Al Qasimiyah School, Al Jubail Vegetable Market, Al Madam Buried Village and Sharjah Museum of Islamic Civilization
events.description: The third Sharjah Architecture Triennial, curated by Vyjayanthi Rao, shows projects about civic infrastructure and collective futures. It is spread over several sites in Sharjah city and at the buried village in Al Madam.
